info.title: Environment Agency Flood Monitoring
info.description: Live flood warnings and alerts for England, keyless. An empty result is the normal, good answer.

get.summary: Current flood alerts and warnings near a coordinate pair
get.description: `items[]` carries `severity` ('Flood alert', 'Flood warning', 'Severe flood warning'), `severityLevel` (3, 2, 1 — LOWER is worse), `description` (the area) and `timeRaised`.

200.description: Active alerts under items; empty means no flood risk right now.
